ideas.pitch: A high-efficiency vision-based lane keeping and obstacle avoidance system tailored for scaled autonomous vehicles running on constrained edge hardware.
ideas.problem_statement: The Urban Autonomous Mobility Challenge: navigating a miniature urban circuit, lane discipline, and pedestrian safety.
ideas.title: LaneNet-Lite: Edge TPU Scaled Autonomous Lane Keeping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven edge AI design patterns from winning JetBot navigation projects combined with robust real-world performance under strict hardware constraints.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed safety system using a localized camera feed to instantly detect traffic signals, stop signs, and sudden pedestrian crossings for autonomous braking.
ideas.problem_statement: The Urban Autonomous Mobility Challenge: handling intersections, pedestrian safety, and dynamic traffic as complexity scales.
ideas.title: V2X-SignGuard: Ultra-Low Latency Dynamic Traffic Sign & Pedestrian Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on safety-critical edge inference, echoing industrial safety and robotics competition winners that prized absolute reliability.

ideas.pitch: A robust mapping and localization routine enabling the scaled autonomous vehicle to identify vacant parking bays and execute closed-loop parallel parking maneuvers.
ideas.problem_statement: The Urban Autonomous Mobility Challenge: vehicle parking capabilities in a miniature urban environment.
ideas.title: AutoPark-SLAM: Precision Miniature Parallel Parking System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses one of the most notoriously difficult components of scaled autonomous driving competitions with a deterministic, easily demonstrable live routine.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight remote monitoring dashboard providing real-time telemetry, camera feed streaming, and emergency override capabilities for autonomous delivery pods.
ideas.problem_statement: The Urban Autonomous Mobility Challenge: navigating complete urban circuits under dynamic conditions with reliability and monitoring.
ideas.title: FedEx-FleetGrid: Telemetry and Mission Control Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with title sponsor branding and practical fleet management requirements, giving judges an interface to view vehicle health during testing runs.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized coordination script allowing multiple scaled autonomous vehicles to negotiate right-of-way at unmarked intersections using localized peer-to-peer communication.
ideas.problem_statement: The Urban Autonomous Mobility Challenge: handling complex intersections and dynamic traffic escalation rounds.
ideas.title: IntersecFlow: Multi-Vehicle Intersection Priority Resolver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced multi-agent coordination capabilities that set top-tier robotics entries apart from basic line-followers.
